_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

income-tax-office.alt: The zero-shaped steel pylon of the Shunya cable-stayed bridge in Bandra Kurla Complex, with MMRDA written across its top, against a blue sky with cranes and buildings under construction behind
income-tax-office.caption: The pylon of the Shunya bridge, which takes the line over the Vakola nallah between Income Tax Office and ILFS

eeh.alt: The side of EEH station's concourse and platform levels in bare concrete and brick, with the steel roof frame going up on top, above shops and a tin-roofed building
eeh.caption: The station from the street, with the roof frame going up

eeh.alt: Looking up from a lane at the underside of the EEH station viaduct on its round pier, with the station's grey concrete floors and green safety nets behind
eeh.caption: The viaduct and pier at the end of the station

eeh.alt: A man climbs a wide concrete staircase up to the EEH station building, beside green netting and coconut palms, with rubble in front
eeh.caption: The entrance stairs up to the station

esic-nagar.alt: Girder launching work underway at Juhu Circle.
